name: Default
shortDescription: Read-only proxy that serves the albums and photos you share from Immich to the public, without exposing your Immich server.

alerts.message: Needs an existing Immich 3.0 or newer server. The default IMMICH_URL reaches an Immich app from this catalog in the same environment; for another server set IMMICH_URL to its internal (not public) URL and redeploy. Then in Immich, under Server Settings, set the External domain to this app's URL so share links point at the proxy.
